import hashlib, os, re, subprocess, sys

              "docs/criteria/security_ops_verification.md"]

    return {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if k not in KEYS}
def git(args):

def rev(spec):
    out, _, rc = git(["rev-parse", "--revs-only", spec])
    r = out.decode("utf-8", "replace").strip()
    return r if rc == 0 and r else ""
def merge_base(ref):
    if not rev(ref):
        return ""

    b = out.decode("utf-8", "replace").strip()

def blob_at(rev_, path):

def product_like(cand):

    if rc != 0:
        return True
    w = cr(open("docs/plan.md", "rb").read())
    at = blob_at(cand, "docs/plan.md")
    return at is not None and at == w

work_text = cr(open("docs/plan.md", "rb").read()).decode("utf-8")
def section(text):

    rest = text[m0.end():]

# even if its own text is innocent, because the fence cannot tell a re-wrap from a
